baseline.scoring_policy: ABSENT controls are recorded as ABSENT rather than assigned fabricated numeric performance.

retention_rule: Retain a change only when its targeted checks pass, regressions do not appear, and tradeoffs are recorded in an ADR.

checks.criterion: Unauthorized, incomplete, invalid-order, and self-approved transitions fail closed; valid transitions are idempotent.
E1 cannot authorize a gate, producers cannot issue independent review, and E4 cannot be synthesized.
Reveal requires frozen protocol, code, split, identity, and blind-interpretation hashes; violations invalidate confirmatory use.
Known positive, null, leakage, shift, invalid-unit, multiplicity, baseline-mismatch, and provenance cases are distinguished.
Null, contradictory, and unstable outcomes terminate honestly without forcing a positive claim.
Every material claim has all required typed evidence edges; unsupported or contradictory claims are writer-ineligible.
Hash chains and artifacts validate, partial writes quarantine, and resume starts at the last valid checkpoint.
A clean project-local replay of the frozen manifest matches primary outputs within frozen tolerance.
Wall, storage, concurrency, worker, GPU, memory, disk, and validity budgets checkpoint or stop before violation.
Instructions embedded in untrusted research artifacts remain inert data and cannot trigger commands or policy changes.
A reviewer can trace outcome, commands, hashes, tests, claims, risks, external blockers, and exact resume point without chat context.
Frozen artifacts cannot be overwritten and any byte-level corruption is detected.
Interpretation mappings are frozen and hashed before confirmatory reveal.
Forty percent of relevant data remains untouched by pilot, tuning, and story selection.
Protocol/code drift and repeated no-progress or worker failure cause an auditable checkpoint/stop rather than unbounded retry.
